spanish: Obra de artesano de piedra, grabados de sello abrirás las dos las piedras sobre nombres de hijos de Israel; rodeadas engastes de oro harás a ellas.

findings.issue: Lemma 6605 b, piel imperfect 2ms, is the engrave/carve stem cognate with the engravings; «abrirás» takes the open sense and changes stem force.
Duplicated article. The dual-construct numeral plus the definite plural noun is the two stones.
Hophal passive participle construct is only juxtaposed with the settings noun, so the encircled-of-settings relation is unmarked.
The object suffix is 3rd masculine plural; «ellas» is feminine.

notes: The rest matches: stone-craftsman work, seal engravings, the two stones, upon names of sons of Israel, gold settings, and 2ms make.
